title: Salesforce Pricing Plans for Singapore [2025] - Wise
text:
Let's start with the basics: Salesforce works on a subscription model where you pay per user, per month. Your total cost comes down to three main things:

1. Which "cloud" or product you need (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, etc.)
2. Which tier or edition you choose (Essentials, Professional, Enterprise, etc.)
3. How many people in your team need access

This setup means you can start small and scale up as your business grows. No need to pay for more than you need right now.

Salesforce offers several "clouds" or platforms, each designed for specific business functions. Most clouds offer multiple tiers or editions, typically categorised as Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Enterprise, and Unlimited, with increasing functionality and capabilities at each level. Salesforce has also introduced Einstein 1 editions that incorporate advanced AI capabilities into their offerings. Some products, such as Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud, have unique pricing models.

Below is a comprehensive breakdown of the two primary Salesforce clouds and their pricing tiers (user/month).

| Edition | Sales Cloud² | Service Cloud³ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | USD 25 | USD 25 |
| Pro Suite | USD 100 | USD 80 |
| Enterprise | USD 165 | USD 165 |
| Unlimited | USD 330 | USD 330 |
| Einstein 1 | USD 500 | USD 500 |

* Details accurate as of April 15, 2025

All prices are billed annually and subject to change based on specific business requirements and agreements.

### What is the pricing currency for Salesforce in Singapore?

Salesforce lists its prices in USD for most of its products on its Asia Pacific website. However, for some products like Service Cloud, they offer the option to be billed in other currencies including USD, AUD, GBP, EUR, JPY and SEK.

...

#### Starter Suite plan pricing

The Starter Suite plan costs USD 25 per user per month (billed annually) and is specifically designed for small businesses with up to 10 users. This entry-level plan includes²:

- Basic lead and opportunity management
- Account and contact management
- Key integrations with popular apps
- Mobile access
- Basic reports and dashboards

#### Pro Suite plan pricing

Priced at USD 100 per user per month (billed annually), the Pro Suite plan is suitable for growing businesses that need additional functionality and customisation options. It includes everything in the Starter Suite plan, plus²:

- Lead assignment and routing
- Campaign management
- Collaborative forecasting
- Customisable dashboards
- Role-based permissions
- Unlimited users

#### Enterprise plan pricing

The Enterprise plan costs USD 165 per user per month (billed annually) and is designed for larger organisations requiring advanced CRM capabilities. This plan includes all Professional features, plus²:

- Territory management
- Opportunity teams
- Custom app development
- Advanced reporting
- Workflow and approval automation
- Integration via web services API
- Unlimited users

#### Unlimited plan pricing

At USD 330 per user per month (billed annually), the Unlimited plan offers the most comprehensive set of features for businesses with complex sales processes. It includes all Enterprise features, plus²:

- 24/7 toll-free support
- Unlimited custom applications
- Multiple sandboxes for development and testing
- Premier Success Plan
- Unlimited online training
- Full sandbox for development and testing

#### Einstein 1 Sales pricing

The Einstein 1 Sales plan is priced at USD 500 per user per month and includes all Unlimited features plus advanced AI capabilities. At such a high per-user price, it’s only really suitable for larger businesses dealing with very high-value leads. Key additions include²:

...

- Revenue Intelligence for Sales Cloud: USD 220/user/month for purpose-built analytics throughout the sales cycle².
- Partner Relationship Management for Sales Cloud: USD 10/user/month for personalised partner experiences².
- SMS Credits for Marketing Cloud: USD 10/1,000 credits to leverage mobile messaging⁴.
- Segmentation and Activation Card for Marketing Cloud: USD 1,000/100,000 credits to create additional segments⁴.

title: Salesforce Announces Pricing Update - Salesforce
text:

Today, we’re announcing:

- New Agentforce add-ons and Agentforce 1 Editions are now generally available
- Prices for Enterprise and Unlimited Editions are going up on August 1, 2025
- Updates to Slack plans, including new AI features for all paid plans and the addition of Salesforce channels to all Slack plans, including the free plan

Last month we announced new flexible Agentforce pricing — including Flex Credits, a consumption-based model that aligns cost with jobs to be done, and new Agentforce user licenses and add-ons that include unmetered employee agent usage. 

Today, Agentforce add-ons and Agentforce 1 Editions are generally available for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, and Industries Clouds. These new offerings replace the existing Einstein add-ons and Einstein 1 Editions. 

New Agentforce add-ons, starting at $125 per user per month, can be added to Enterprise Editions and Unlimited Editions, giving users access to key benefits including:

- Unmetered usage of generative AI and Agentforce for employees for licensed users 
- Pre-built Agentforce templates by role and industry that accelerate productivity and time to value — like a banking service assistant for Financial services that helps bankers resolve account issues faster, or a patient services template for Life Sciences that helps reps update benefits information
- Access to our full suite of predictive, generative, and agentic capabilities that work seamlessly together, creating a better experience for your customers and employees 
- AI-powered analytics with Tableau Next to accelerate decision-making and action across teams
- Prompt Builder

Agentforce 1 Editions, starting at $550 per user per month, offer the most comprehensive suite of AI capabilities with Cloud-specific point solutions, giving users access to: 

- Everything included in Agentforce add-ons
- Bundled cloud-specific product add-ons that offer expanded features and greater value, packaged together at a lower total cost
- 1 million Flex Credits per org per year
- Seamlessly swap user licenses with Flex Credits
- Data Cloud with 2.5 million Data Services Credits per org per year
- New Slack Enterprise+ 

#### Price Increases for Enterprise and Unlimited Editions‌ — ‌Coming Soon

We’re also updating pricing for Enterprise Editions and Unlimited Editions for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, ​Field Service, and select Industries Clouds. On August 1, 2025, list prices will increase by an average of ​6%. These increases reflect the significant ongoing innovation and customer value delivered through our products. There are no planned changes to pricing for Salesforce Foundations, Starter, or Pro Editions.

#### New Slack Plans with More AI Features

We’re also updating Slack plans and pricing — including adding the latest AI features to all paid plans, like the ability to deploy multiple employee-facing AI agents directly in Slack so employees can collaborate with them right alongside their human coworkers. Slack’s Business+ plan is now $15 per user per month, and we’re introducing a new Enterprise+ plan that includes enterprise search capabilities and enhanced security, admin controls, governance, and compliance.

title: Salesforce Starter Suite - Review 2025 - PCMag Middle East
text:
## Pricing: Costly, But Packed With Features

Despite introducing new features since our last review, Salesforce Starter Suite continues to cost $25 per user per month, billed annually. That’s on the higher end for the category, but in return, you get a comprehensive set of tools for commerce, marketing, sales, and customer service. Specifically on the CRM front, this plan includes account, contact, and opportunity management; customizable reports and dashboards; and lead assignment and routing.

(Credit: Salesforce/PCMag)

One change involves the user cap for onboarding. Salesforce Starter allowed you to add up to 325 users at a time, while the even older Salesforce Essentials supported just 10 seats. Salesforce Starter Suite strikes a middle ground of 66 users; if you need more seats, you must contact Salesforce directly. This might seem like a minor detail, but this limit appears to be a practical sweet spot for SMBs that need a CRM that’s a step above entry-level

title: Salesforce Editions & Pricing 2025: Essentials vs Professional vs Enterprise
text:
## Salesforce Essentials Pricing 2025: For Small Teams

Salesforce Essentials is designed for small businesses and startups that are new to CRM software. It focuses on core CRM features without unnecessary complexity.

This edition includes lead and opportunity tracking, contact and account management, email integration, basic reports, and mobile access. It is easy to set up and works well for teams that want to organize sales activities without heavy customization.

Salesforce Essentials pricing in 2025 starts at $25 per user per month, billed annually. Pricing is per user and may vary by region.

Essentials is best for businesses with small teams that want a simple CRM to manage customers and sales pipelines without advanced automation or integrations.

## Salesforce Professional Edition Pricing 2025: For Growing Businesses

The Salesforce Professional edition is a step up from Essentials and is designed for growing businesses that need better visibility and control over sales activities.

In addition to everything included in Essentials, Professional offers features such as sales forecasting, campaign management, customizable dashboards, and more detailed reporting. It helps sales teams track performance and make data-driven decisions.

Salesforce Professional pricing in 2025 is $75 per user per month, billed annually.

This edition is ideal for businesses that are expanding, have multiple sales reps, and need better insights but do not yet require complex automation or deep system integrations.

## Salesforce Enterprise Edition Pricing 2025: Most Popular Choice

Salesforce Enterprise is the most commonly chosen edition by mid-sized and large businesses. It offers significantly more flexibility and customization than Essentials or Professional.

Enterprise includes advanced workflow automation, approval processes, role-based access control, custom objects, and full API access for integrations. This allows businesses to connect Salesforce with other systems and build tailored CRM workflows.

Salesforce Enterprise edition pricing in 2025 is $150 per user per month, billed annually.

If your business requires automation, integrations, custom reporting, or industry-specific workflows, Enterprise is often the best long-term choice. It scales well as teams and processes grow.

## Salesforce Unlimited Edition Pricing 2025: Full Feature Access

Salesforce Unlimited is designed for large organizations with complex CRM needs. It includes all Enterprise features plus additional benefits such as 24/7 priority support, unlimited custom apps, and advanced sandbox environments for testing and development.

Unlimited edition pricing in 2025 is $300 per user per month, billed annually.

This edition is best suited for enterprises that require deep customization, high system availability, ongoing development, and premium support. While the cost is higher, it offers maximum flexibility and control.

title: Salesforce CRM pricing – Is it worth the cost?
text:
### Salesforce CRM pricing plans

Essentials – $25 per user per month

- Basic account and contact management
- Lead management and email integration
- Salesforce mobile app
- Lacks advanced automation, reporting, and customization options.

Professional – $75 per user per month

- Pipeline and opportunity tracking
- Custom dashboards and reports for customer data
- Collaborative forecasting tools
- Higher cost compared to alternatives offering similar features.

Enterprise Salesforce plan – $150 per user per month

- Unlimited CRM customizations
- Advanced workflow automation for a fully customizable sales process
- API integration for external systems
- Expensive for small-to-medium businesses.

Unlimited Salesforce plan - $300 per user per month

- Dedicated account management
- Advanced pipeline management
- Premier support and onboarding services
- Unlimited access to all Salesforce features
- It is prohibitively expensive for all but the largest enterprises.

Salesforce’s base price looks reasonable – but add-ons like Marketing Cloud, Einstein AI, and extra storage quickly add up. Advanced features often require upgrades, making costs harder to predict. For detailed pricing information, you need to contact Salesforce.
